title: Yevgenia's Black Swan
coreMove: Study a visible winner while keeping the invisible field of failed alternatives in view.
sourcePressure: Yevgenia Krasnova shows how one improbable success gets rewritten as if the path had been visible before the outcome.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating breakout success as meaningless or as a simple recipe to copy.

sourceAnchors.name: Yevgenia Krasnova
sourceAnchors.detail: a fictional author whose improbable rise is later narrated as if it were written in advance
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Yevgenia looks inevitable only after the bookshelf has already made room for her.

hook: A shock arrives and proves everyone wrong
The future refuses to follow the script
A quiet morning hides a lesson about uncertainty
counterintuition: The thing that looks rational is actually irrational
examples: same analyst staring at a dashboard
coffee-shop founder deciding whether to pivot

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples, drawn from: timestamp+name+action, dialogue first line, sensory detail first, second-person direct address, retrospective, question-as-hook, environmental detail before any human
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: C8 catches Cartesian repetition of phrases but not the deeper template of 'timestamp + named protagonist + prop + decision' that makes 6 examples feel like 1 example with name swaps

rhythmVariety.deepReadParagraphLengthMix: at least one paragraph 3 sentences or shorter, at least one paragraph 5+ sentences, at least one one-sentence punch line
rhythmVariety.fullReadInterludeRequirement: at least one paragraph that breaks the scene-then-rule rhythm: a direct second-person passage, a research aside, a brief historical reference, or a question to the reader
rhythmVariety.forbiddenRhythm: every paragraph following the pattern 'concrete anchor sentence -> abstract rule sentence -> elaboration sentence'
